title: One strength rating for the field
overseerSummary: Rating taken from the fighter itself, fitted on a 432-cell grid that includes healers and geared squads. Must land before the readout shows any odds.

proposals.title: One strength reading for both sides of the field, taken from the fighter
proposals.problem: Stand, hold, pounce, retreat and the hostile decision to collect allies before closing all read Field.odds (power x health). Squad actors enter it with power 4 whatever their stars, class, gear or DEX, and hostile power and health come from a five-row grade table with no level term (a level-10 forest rat has 1.9x the HP and 1.9x the damage of a level-3 one and the same table row). Measured over 13,565 threat readings in 1,800 combat.js-backed sorties (random 3-5 star squads of up to 4, 15 contract types, levels 2-6): median reading 0.97, 8% below the stand/pounce line (GOOD 0.6), 1% below the retreat line (HOPELESS 0.35). Against combat.js win rates over 432 matchups the reading has Spearman 0.39, so a 1-star and a 5-star squad read the same against the same pack. Correction to the earlier draft: the committed plain-resolver harness also fires these plays rarely (0.17 details and 0.09 stands per run over 15 types at POW 0.45; 0.02 and 0.00 with the inputs the game produces). The earlier 2.05 and 1.85 came from a five-type subset dominated by raid, run with different seeds, and should not be cited.
evidence: field.js:2059 `power: c.power || 4, speed: BASE_SPEED * (c.speed || 1)`; nothing outside test/field.harness.js:38 sets c.power or c.speed. sortie.js:149-150 copies only maxHp and hp from the fighter back to the actor.

field.js:80-81 and 1679-1680: hostile power and starting HP come from GRADE_POWER / GRADE_HP by grade (times swarm and mark factors); mission level is not an input. makeActor is the only constructor of hostile actors: field.js:2063 (initial spawns) and field.js:1649 (spawnGroup, which waves and escalation use).

field.js:1106-1115 odds(); tactics.js:154 judge() reads it; tactics.js:273-276, 300, 322 gate stand, pounce and retreat on `oddsHere < ok` (GOOD 0.6, tactics.js:135) or `< HOPELESS` (0.35, tactics.js:132); field.js:60 and 825 gate the hostile rally on odds(pack, squad) < RALLY_AT 0.45. Today pack-vs-squad odds are near 0, so rally() returned a target on 207 evaluations per run versus 154 with the rating (180 runs; counted per hostile per step, so the ratio is the figure).

Scratch otv4.js (sysrev folder): 432 cells = 4 squad compositions (melee; fighter+cleric+mage+ranger; mage+cleric+alchemist+mage; two fighters+two clerics) x ungeared/Fine-geared x levels 3/8/14 x stars 1/3/5 x six packs, 8 combat.js encounters per cell. Spearman against win rate, shipped reading vs rating: all 0.39 vs 0.86; melee 0.38/0.86; mixed 0.39/0.87; caster-heavy 0.40/0.84; double healer 0.40/0.86; ungeared 0.35/0.85; geared 0.40/0.87.

Same script, calibration: classification of win>0.5 by odds>0.5 is 88% at K=1.0, 92% at K=1.5, 91% at K=2.0, 88% at K=2.5, 85% at K=3.0. Median reading of the 54 cells with a win rate between 0.2 and 0.8 is 0.44 at K=1.5 and 0.51 at K=2.0. Accuracy at K=1.5 by composition: melee 94%, mixed 94%, caster-heavy 90%, double healer 92%. Healing is not in the formula and the double-healer squads still fit.

Scratch real2.js (copy of sortie.js fighterFor/resolve/REGEN tick driving Field.step; patched copy of field.js with the hook), 1,800 runs per variant, same missions and squads: shipped inputs: win 48%, 0.61 deaths/run, plays 0.22/run, stands 0.21/run, retreats 0.00/run, closing-threat readings median 0.97, p10 0.64. With rating K=2.0 (power and guard only): win 47%, 0.61 deaths/run, plays 0.36, stands 0.28, retreats 0.05, readings median 0.86, p10 0.45, 20% below GOOD, 5% below HOPELESS.

Same driver with squad walking speed also taken from walkSpeed (clamped 0.9-1.1 of BASE_SPEED, stats.js:49 has no reader today): win 42%, 0.55 deaths/run. Not neutral, so it is kept out of this proposal (see risks).
proposals.change: 1) combat.js: move the stat block of fromMonster into baseOfMonster(def, level, mods), which fromMonster calls. It builds no fighter and draws no RNG, so a species can be rated before anything spawns. Add rating(f) returning { power, guard }: power = max(base.damage, base.magicDamage) x (base.speed / BAR) x (1 + base.crit x (base.critDamage - 1)); guard = 1 + base.armor / 10. Export both. 2) sortie.js fighterFor, after the cohesion multipliers: squad actors take a.power = RATE_K x rating(fighter).power and a.guard = rating(fighter).guard; hostile actors take both from their spawned fighter with no RATE_K. RATE_K = 2.0. 3) field.js start() and restore() accept a rate(species, group) hook and keep it on the run. makeActor uses it for power, hp, maxHp and guard when it returns a value and falls back to GRADE_POWER / GRADE_HP otherwise (field.html, bare parties, tests). sortie.js supplies rateFoe(species, group): rating of baseOfMonster(def, level, { tierMult: mean of M.TIERS[tier][0..1] }) at level = mission level + GRADE_BUMP[grade] + levelOffset (the expression fighterFor uses), cached per species and level. 4) field.js fightHp multiplies each actor's hp by (a.guard || 1), so a wounded squad reads weaker. 'guard' is added to ACTOR_KEYS (field.js:1939) so a resumed run keeps it; the duplicate 'noFightUntil' in that list is removed in the same edit. 5) test/rating.harness.js (new) reproduces the fit above and prints Spearman per composition and the K sweep; RATE_K is the value where the median reading of the 0.2-0.8 win-rate cells is 0.5. 6) test/field.harness.js passes the same hook in place of the invented c.maxHp, c.power and c.speed (POW stays as the scale knob) and prints stands, details and retreats per run before and after, at POW 0.6 and 0.45, 40 runs per type. GOOD, HOPELESS, EDGE and RALLY_AT stay unchanged unless the counts leave the ranges recorded in memory.
proposals.playerEffect: Who is in the squad and what they carry changes what the squad does before a fight, and the log names it. With K=2.0, 20% of closing-threat readings fall below the stand/pounce line (8% today) and 5% below the retreat line (1% today); plays per run go from 0.22 to 0.36 and retreats from 0.00 to 0.05. A weak squad reads 'they fall back to the way in' where a strong one stands. Aggregate outcomes do not move (win 48% to 47%, deaths 0.61 to 0.61 per run, 1,800 runs each), so this changes decisions without changing difficulty. It is also the prerequisite for any odds line shown to the player: the shipped reading must not be displayed.
proposals.secondOrder: Smithy output, class, stars, sacrifices, meals and the cohesion multipliers now change tactics, because the rating reads the fighter after Stats.effective and after the sortie.js multipliers. Hostile groups that out-rate the squad stop collecting allies first (rally evaluations -26%), so strong packs close faster and weak ones still gather. loop-readout can show Field.odds as a number the player can check against the squad sheet. Cohesion order matters: rating must be read after the multipliers at sortie.js:126-131. Meals and willpower seeds feed it automatically.
proposals.risks: Outcomes are unchanged at the current thresholds, so the value is fidelity and the readout dependency, not balance. The fit is 90-94% accurate at classifying a coin-flip cell and was measured on 8 encounters per cell; the committed script should use 16. Healing is not in the formula; the fit held for double-healer squads but a squad built around a single high-value heal is not measured. Armour is a flat per-hit subtraction in Elements.slice, so 1 + armor/10 is an approximation (a variant modelling it against the opposing mean hit scored 0.84 against 0.83 in an earlier run). Hostile ratings before first contact use mean tier and no rarity or modifier; after contact they use the spawned fighter. Walking speed from walkSpeed is excluded: with it the same driver gave win 42% and 0.55 deaths/run (1,800 runs), a 6-point win drop for 0.06 fewer deaths, which is a separate decision for the user.
proposals.response: Design attack, fit and harness: the grid now includes clerics, alchemists, mages, double-healer squads and Fine-geared squads (432 cells, Spearman 0.84-0.87 per composition against 0.38-0.40 shipped). The harness switches to the same hook (step 6). The claim that the harness 'tunes tactics against a situation the game never produces' was overstated: the harness fires the plays rarely too; I withdrew the 2.05/1.85 figures and replaced them with 0.17/0.09 (harness inputs) and 0.02/0.00 (game inputs). Speed: I tested the clamp the antagonist asked for. It is not neutral, so speed is removed from this proposal and offered as a separate switch with its measured cost. Before/after counts at POW 0.6 and 0.45 on the committed harness are a build-step deliverable; the combat-backed table above is the equivalent now. Lands before loop-readout's odds line. Engineering attack: 'guard' is added to ACTOR_KEYS; hostile values arrive through makeActor, which both initial spawns and spawnGroup (waves, escalation) use, and restore() takes the hook; the calibration grid covers healer, caster and geared squads; stand/retreat/rally counts are reported before and after. Size stays M: four files plus one new test, one new hook, no new state beyond 'guard'.

verdicts.attack: It swaps one magic table for a fitted constant (RATE_K about 2.3) and makes the field's judgement depend on combat.js, so the committed harness (plain resolver, invented power) stops describing the game unless it is switched to the same hook, and every tactics threshold (GOOD 0.6, HOPELESS 0.35, EDGE 0.05, RALLY_AT 0.45) was tuned on the old distribution. Per-member speed from walkSpeed strings squads out and gets the slow member killed under permadeath, which is the opposite of what the user values.
verdicts.evidenceCheck: Verified: field.js:2059 power: c.power || 4, speed: BASE_SPEED x (c.speed || 1); grep finds c.power/c.speed only in test/field.harness.js:38; my Node build gives power 4, speed 0.55 for a 1-star and a 5-star Fighter alike; sortie.js:149-150 copies only maxHp/hp; field.js:1679-1680 hostile power/HP from GRADE_POWER/GRADE_HP with no level term; odds() field.js:1109-1115; gates at tactics.js:273-276, 300, 322; rally at field.js:825. NOT reproduced: 'plays fire 2.05 details / 1.85 stands per run with harness inputs'. The committed test/field.harness.js gives 0.07 details / 0.04 stands per run at POW 0.6 (420 runs) and 0.17 / 0.09 at POW 0.45 (300 runs), so the harness also barely fires them; the 0.00 with browser inputs follows from the arithmetic (four members at power 4 with real HP read above GOOD against anything short of two legendaries). Spearman 0.34 vs 0.83 is from the builder's odds_vs_truth3.js on gearless melee squads and was not re-run.
verdicts.demand: Land before loop-readout's odds line. Include healers, casters and geared squads in the RATE_K fit (a healer's value is not max(damage, magicDamage)). Clamp squad speed to 0.9-1.1 of BASE_SPEED in the first pass. Switch test/field.harness.js to the same rating hook and report stands/details per run before and after on the committed harness, with any GOOD/HOPELESS/RALLY_AT retune shown as numbers and the aggregate deaths/run not rising.

verdicts.attack: It changes every odds-gated behaviour at once (stand, pounce, retreat, rally, broken lines) and moves the attrition resolver's inputs for field.html and the harness, so GOOD, HOPELESS, EDGE, RALLY_AT and the broken lines all need re-fitting; the fit was measured on gearless melee squads, so a Cleric or Alchemist rates low under max(damage, magicDamage) and the calibration could make support squads read as hopeless. Size is M-L, not M.
verdicts.evidenceCheck: Verified field.js:2059 gives every character power 4 and BASE_SPEED x 1 (no code sets c.power or c.speed outside test/field.harness.js:38); sortie.js:149-150 copies only hp and maxHp; makeActor (field.js:1679-1680) uses GRADE_POWER/GRADE_HP and ignores level; odds at field.js:1106-1115; tactics gates at 273-276, 300, 322; rally RALLY_AT at field.js:825; walkSpeed (stats.js:49) has no reader. My Node check: four (p4, hp220) vs six basics 0.95, vs twelve veterans 0.60, vs three elites 0.76, vs one ancient 0.86, vs one legendary 0.57; so nothing below legendary drops under GOOD and the plays cannot fire. Spearman figures not re-run.
verdicts.demand: 1) Add 'guard' to ACTOR_KEYS. 2) Hostile power and hp arrive through the namer/rate hook at makeActor time, including spawnGroup for waves and escalation, never through fighterFor. 3) The calibration grid includes cleric/alchemist/caster and geared squads and the harness uses the same hook. 4) Lands before loop-readout's odds line and before systems-will-axis tuning. 5) Report stand/retreat/rally counts before and after at POW 0.6 and 0.45, 40 runs per type, per the harness memory.
